release.notes: Samostatné balíky IPTV rádií pre Austria, Germany, Hungary a Poland. Každá krajina má vlastný výber, archívy a overené Warder picony. Pôvodný SK/CZ balík a nastavenia zostávajú zachované. Po aktualizácii reštartujte GUI.

notes_i18n.cs: Separate IPTV radio packages for Austria, Germany, Hungary and Poland. Each country has its own selection, archives and verified Warder picons. The existing SK/CZ package and saved profiles are preserved. Restart the GUI after updating.
